main.description: Apply a local content label to a post. Instance authority and actor identity come from the authenticated service context, never request fields. The effect is URI-scoped while the CID records inspection and concurrency; !takedown and unsupported values return UnsupportedLabel.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an authorized service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor lacks permission; do not retry unless its moderation authority changes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request fields are inconsistent or incomplete; correct the request before retrying.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The subject is malformed, unsupported, or not a post; correct the subject before retrying.

errors.name: SubjectNotFound
errors.description: The subject cannot be found for inspection; verify the reference before retrying.

errors.name: ContentChanged
errors.description: The subject CID changed; refetch getSubjectState and re-inspect the current content before retrying.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is stale; refetch getSubjectState before retrying with the new version.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: UnsupportedReason
errors.description: The reason is not supported for this action; choose a supported reason before retrying.

errors.name: UnsupportedLabel
errors.description: The label value is unsupported; use the supported nsfw value before retrying.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

input.description: Request to apply a local content label to an inspected post

subject.description: Post reference whose URI receives the label and whose CID establishes inspection concurrency

expectedVersion.description: Opaque subject-state version expected by the caller

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes equivalent label requests idempotent

reason.description: Public reason classification for applying the label

privateNote.description: Private administrative note retained only on the admin action
